scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's storm-related speed drop and sync instability in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at [08:15] for her router serial number which had already been verified at [00:45].

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Deflected responsibility at [04:45] by refusing to escalate ticket and telling customer frontline staff cannot assist with wholesale repairs.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Spoke rudely and defensively at [03:45] stating 'Well if you had actually installed a surge protector plug... your router wouldn't be retraining...'

grader.scenario: Broadband sync speed dropped by half following Openreach cabinet lightning strike
grader.notes: Good demonstration of an 'okay' 4-fault call where the agent demonstrated appropriate empathy regarding tax accounting deadlines, but failed paraphrasing, active listening, rapport, and ownership.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net broadband network faults' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Holds announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Lara throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at [02:50] ('I completely understand that speed drops during busy tax accounting periods cause immediate stress, Lara.') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the thunderstorm damage and halved speed in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for router serial number at turn 25 despite customer stating SN-88210 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent refused to escalate ticket to management, deflecting responsibility to wholesale queues.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at [03:45]: 'Well if you had actually installed a surge protector plug... your router wouldn't be retraining every fifteen minutes.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding physical damage and router sync light status.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer noted monitoring ticket TKT-44019-L and agreed to 3-5 day engineering timeframe.
